Peter V'landys Steps Down as Racing NSW Boss

Peter V'landys has stepped down as the boss of Racing NSW. This move is intended to allow him to secure a firmer grip on the National Rugby League (NRL). His leadership has been described as being pulled into racing's 'hot contest'.
